rules: Battle plates: detached slanted R0 hairline #181820 (owner-locked; never relitigate flush/square).
Trunks: 4px narrow stub on south-ground fringe only; interior trunkless (owner-locked).
Text raster: 1-bit bitmap atlas, integer fillRect, no smoothing (DS hardware has no AA).
Meadow: parity checkerboard weave #5da862/#57a05c + speckle (owner direction R12).
Grass fringe: hash-scattered broken tufts, no continuous lip; clustered via low-freq hash.
Sprites: faceless backs, nape caps, solid mouth bands + single mouth lines, arched cylinders.
Textbox: no name plate, 2-line windows, inline speaker, measure-wrap.
bar.instruction: Critics: judge ONLY gaps outside these rules. Citing a locked rule as a gap is an automatic invalid verdict.
